easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
description:
Cast Insult by paying {2}{R}.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah.
